ai_workflow.preamble: REPLACE ME: one sentence saying this is a composable ai-rulesmith rules library (rules under src/rules/, profiles under src/profiles/) plus its docs site. Install with `task install`, validate with `task validate`, list rules with `task list`, rebuild agent files with `task build`, build the site with `task docs:build`. Everyday work: Implement, then Review, then Verify. Skip Specify, Design, and Release unless this session is a large redesign or a ship.

steps.description: Add or amend rules, profiles, and handwritten docs. Propose rule text before writing files when the change is a new practice.
Review the change for correctness, clarity, and rule-library constraints before handing it back.
Confirm the library still validates and the docs site still builds. Done when `task validate` and `task docs:build` (or `task ci`) succeed.
